title: Agentic Tool-Use Amplifies Jailbreak Consequences: When Robustness Failure Meets Autonomy

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Highly relevant: as models become agents, measuring whether jailbreaks translate to actual tool calls vs text-only output directly informs agentic deployment risk. Clear causal chain from finding to deployment policy.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires setting up an agentic harness with tool access around an open-source LLM, which adds meaningful infrastructure complexity. Beginners would need substantial mentor guidance for the agentic scaffolding, though the jailbreak evaluation part is standard.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Two experimental setups needed: agentic harness and standard chat. Building a reliable agentic harness with file/web tools is a sub-project in itself. Could exceed 30 hours if harness development takes long.
